api.slow_down: You're playing very fast. Take a breather and try again in a minute.

api.expired: This run went on too long to count. Press start again.

api.over_ceiling: That score is beyond what this game allows.

pack.too_big: That pack is too large once unpacked.
pack.unsafe_path: The pack has a file path that isn't allowed: {path}

pack.no_manifest: The pack needs an insertcoin.json manifest at its top level.

settings.show_nav: Show Arcade in the forum's sidebar
settings.outlier_factor_help: A score this many times the current record (or that fraction of it, where lower wins) is held for a moderator. 3 by default.
settings.outlier_players_help: Only once a game has this many players, so the first few scores aren't flagged against a thin board.
settings.crown_points_help: Paid through FoF Gamification when it is enabled. 0 pays nothing.

games.title: Games
games.help: Drag to set the order of the arcade floor. Games uploaded as packs start switched off, so you can try them first.
games.queue: {count, plural, one {# score waiting for review} other {# scores waiting for review}}
games.uploaded: {title} was added. It's switched off until you switch it on.
games.add_url: Add a game from another site
games.restored: {count, plural, =0 {Every starter game is already here.} one {# starter game was put back.} other {# starter games were put back.}}
games.legal: A pack is a zip with an insertcoin.json manifest and an HTML entry page; it runs in a sandbox and can't reach your forum. Upload only games you have the right to share.
games.empty: No games. Restore the starter games to get going.
games.delete_confirm: Delete {title}, with all its scores and crowns? This can't be undone.

game.add_title: Add a game from another site
game.title: Title
game.url_help: The page of a game hosted on another site. It runs in a sandboxed frame; to post scores it must use the Insert Coin SDK.
game.thumbnail_help: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, ideally 16 × 10, at least 640 pixels wide.
game.replace_pack_help: Upload a new version of this game. Scores and crowns stay.
game.aspect_help: The screen's shape. Pixels or a ratio both work (16 and 9 for wide screen).
game.fair_play_help: A score above the ceiling, or from a run shorter or longer than these, is refused. Leave the ceiling empty for none.
game.crown_approval_help: A score that would take this game's crown waits in the moderation queue until it's approved.

more.title: More games
more.help: Any HTML5 game can run in the arcade, and three lines of code put its scores on the boards. Check each game's licence before you upload it.
more.guide: Making games work with Insert Coin
more.guide_help: The score SDK, the pack format, the sandbox, and adapting a game you found.
more.js13k_help: A yearly contest of tiny arcade games, many of them open source.
more.github_help: Games whose licence and code you can read, and change.
more.itch_help: The biggest catalogue of indie browser games; ask the author before using one.
more.example_help: A complete, tiny game to copy. Zip the folder and upload it.
